note: Browser features the legacy tier's polyfills cannot supply (DOM APIs, CSS), with the Chrome version that introduced them. A rule applies when minChrome is above the legacy floor in device-tiers.json. Built-in JavaScript methods (Object.entries, Array.prototype.flat and so on) are covered by the legacy plugin's polyfills and are not listed. Tag a line with `legacy-ok: <reason>` to allow a use that has a documented fallback.
